fact: Car 63 left the track at T18 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code and Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing and in-car video evidence. Car 63 was attempting to pass Car 81 on the outside into Turn 15. In doing so Car 63 went off track and completed the overtaking off track. At no time while still being on track was Car 63 in front of Car 81 and therefore did not have the right to the line, but gained a lasting advantage by completing the overtaking off track.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 63 Leaving The Track
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
